series.name: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes
series.notes: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit alarm codes (CityMultiErrorCode_V4.pdf ME SG, official, high) + V3 corroboration + ME UK/IE checklist. PK-relevant commercial line (City Multi sold in PK via PEL). Central controller display. Separate from PUMY file (different outdoor families — never merged).

title.en: Serial communication error / panel communication error
title.ur: Serial communication kharab / panel communication kharab

meaning.en: Communication between the control board, fan board, inverter board or a cleaning-unit board has failed.
meaning.ur: Control board, fan board, inverter board ya cleaning unit board ke darmiyan communication kharab ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Wire breakage or contact failure of connectors CN4A/CN4B (fan board CN80), or CN4/CN2 (INV board)
causes.ur: CN4A/CN4B (fan board CN80) ya CN4/CN2 (INV board) connectors ki wire tooti hui ho ya contact na ban raha ho.

causes.en: Electrical interference causing irregular LED blink, or a loose power/communication wire to the cleaning-unit board
causes.ur: Electrical interference ki wajah se LED blink irregular ho, ya cleaning-unit board ki power/communication wire dhili ho.

solutions.en: Check the listed connectors and cables, then power off and power back on
solutions.ur: Pehle diye gaye connectors aur cables check karein, phir power off karke dobara power on karein.

solutions.en: If the error persists, replace the implicated board (cleaning-unit board or indoor unit board / INV board)
solutions.ur: Agar error khatam na ho to yeh wala board badlein: cleaning-unit board ya indoor unit board / INV board.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 documents the same code as City Multi '403 — comms fault between boards'. Parenthesised values are preliminary codes.
notes.ur: S8 mein isi code ko City Multi '403 — boards ke darmiyan comms fault' ke tor par document kiya hai. Bracket ke andar diye gaye values preliminary codes hain.

title.ur: Discharge temperature bohat zyada badh jana

meaning.en: Discharge temperature has exceeded the limit (110°C+) — typically short of refrigerant or a discharge thermistor problem.
meaning.ur: Discharge temperature limit (110°C+) se zyada ho gayi hai — aam tor par refrigerant kam ya discharge thermistor ki kharabi.

causes.en: Short of refrigerant / gas leak, or service valve not fully open
causes.ur: Refrigerant/gas kam ho ya leak ho, ya service valve puri tarah khula na ho.

causes.en: Defective discharge thermistor TH4, or indoor/outdoor LEV not operating
causes.ur: Discharge thermistor TH4 kharab ho, ya indoor/outdoor LEV theek se kaam na kar raha ho.

causes.en: Outdoor fan problem or abnormal operating conditions
causes.ur: Outdoor fan mein masla ho ya operating conditions gair mamooli hon.

solutions.en: Check the refrigerant charge, confirm the service valve is fully open and inspect the outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Pehle refrigerant charge check karein, service valve puri tarah khula hona confirm karein aur outdoor fan ko dekhein.

solutions.en: Check indoor and outdoor LEV operation and measure thermistor TH4
solutions.ur: Indoor aur outdoor LEV ka kaam check karein aur thermistor TH4 ki resistance naapiye.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8: 'Discharge temperature has exceeded 110°C or more. Short of refrigerant.' Maps to Mr. Slim U2.
notes.ur: S8: 'Discharge temperature 110°C ya us se zyada ho gaya. Refrigerant kam hai.' Is ka matlab Mr. Slim U2 hai.

title.ur: Low pressure kharab

meaning.en: The low pressure sensor read less than 1 bar immediately before start-up.
meaning.ur: Start hone se foran pehle low pressure sensor ne 1 bar se kam parya karha.

causes.en: Low charge / gas leak
causes.ur: Gas kam ho ya leak ho.

causes.en: Blocked filter, closed valve or a faulty low-pressure sensor
causes.ur: Filter band ho, valve band ho ya low-pressure sensor kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the low-pressure sensor reading against gauge pressure and repair any leak
solutions.ur: Low-pressure sensor ki reading gauge pressure se compare karein aur leak ko theek karein.

solutions.en: Check filters, valves and the sensor wiring before re-starting
solutions.ur: Dobara start karne se pehle filters, valves aur sensor ki wiring check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: Present in V4 and S8 (R22/R407c columns).
notes.ur: Yeh V4 aur S8 (R22/R407c columns) mein maujood hai.

title.ur: High pressure kharab

meaning.en: System high pressure exceeds the limit (S8: >29 bar R407c, >38 bar R410A) or the high-pressure sensor disagrees with gauge pressure.
meaning.ur: System ka high pressure limit se zyada ho gaya hai (S8: >29 bar R407c, >38 bar R410A) ya high pressure sensor ki parya gauge pressure se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Dirty/blocked outdoor heat exchanger or faulty outdoor fan
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger ganda/band ho ya outdoor fan kharab ho.

causes.en: Stop valve not fully open, SV1a or LEV2 problem, indoor short air cycle
causes.ur: Stop valve puri tarah khula na ho, SV1a ya LEV2 ka masla ho, ya indoor mein short air cycle ho.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor or its input circuit
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor kharab ho ya us ki input circuit kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor fan, clean the heat exchanger and confirm the service valves are fully open
solutions.ur: Pehle outdoor fan check karein, heat exchanger saaf karein aur confirm karein ke service valves puri tarah khule hain.

solutions.en: Compare the high-pressure sensor reading with gauge pressure and check LEV2 / SV1a
solutions.ur: High-pressure sensor ki reading gauge pressure se milayein aur LEV2 / SV1a check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: V4 check list also references thermistors TH3/TH7 and input voltage at TB1.
notes.ur: V4 check list mein thermistor TH3/TH7 aur TB1 par input voltage ka zikr bhi hai.

title.en: Refrigerant overcharge / abnormal low compressor superheat
title.ur: gys zyadh hogai

meaning.en: The system is overcharged, giving abnormally low compressor superheat.
meaning.ur: System mein refrigerant zyada bhara hai, jis se compressor ka superheat abnormal low ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Excessive refrigerant charge
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge zyada ho jana.

causes.en: LEV1/LEV2 or indoor LEV not metering correctly
causes.ur: LEV1/LEV2 ya indoor LEV theek se refrigerant meter na kar raha ho.

causes.en: Twinning-pipe kit fitted incorrectly
causes.ur: Twinning-pipe kit galat tareeqe se lagi ho.

solutions.en: Recover refrigerant to the specified charge and check LEV1/LEV2 operation
solutions.ur: Refrigerant ko specified charge tak wapas lein aur LEV1/LEV2 ka kaam check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the twinning-pipe kit against the installation manual
solutions.ur: Twinning-pipe kit ko installation manual se compare karke verify karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 wording: 'System overcharge. Abnormal low compressor superheat — discharge thermistor TH4'.
notes.ur: S8 ka alfaz: 'System overcharge hai. Compressor ki superheat abnormal tor par low — discharge thermistor TH4'.

title.en: Drain pump fault / water level in drip tray while cooling
title.ur: Drain pump kharab / cooling ke dauran drip tray mein pani ka level

meaning.en: Water level was detected in the drip tray during cooling operation while the drain pump should be removing it.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke dauran drip tray mein pani ka level mila, jabke drain pump ko yeh nikalna chahiye tha.

causes.en: Drain pump not working, no power to it, or blocked drain
causes.ur: Drain pump chal na raha ho, us mein power na aa rahi ho, ya drain block ho.

causes.en: Temperature sensor circuit fault (open/closed) or float switch stuck
causes.ur: Temperature sensor circuit kharab ho (open/closed) ya float switch atka ho jaye.

causes.en: Valve leak on the indoor unit
causes.ur: Indoor unit ki valve leak kar rahi ho.

solutions.en: Check the drain pump operation, supply and the drain path for blockage
solutions.ur: Drain pump ka kaam, supply aur drain path ko blockage ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Check the float switch resistance with the switch open and closed, and check the indoor unit valves for leaks
solutions.ur: Float switch ko khula aur band karke us ki resistance check karein, aur indoor unit valves mein leak ke liye dekhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 also documents 2503 (float-sensor variant) and 2500 (lack of water flow on a water circuit).
notes.ur: S8 mein yeh dono bhi document kiye gaye hain: 2503 (float-sensor variant) aur 2500 (water circuit mein flow ki kami).

title.ur: Power ka ek phase missing ho gaya hai

meaning.en: One phase is missing at the power supply terminal block.
meaning.ur: Power supply ke terminal block mein se ek phase mojood nahi hai.

causes.en: Incoming supply missing a phase, blown fuse, or noise-filter/wiring fault
causes.ur: Aane wali supply mein ek phase missing ho, fuse uda ho, ya noise-filter/wiring mein kharabi ho.

causes.en: Low voltage at CN3 / CNAC (below 198 V) or a short/earth fault on the control board
causes.ur: CN3 / CNAC par voltage low ho (198 V se neeche), ya control board par short/earth fault ho.

solutions.en: Check input voltage at TB1 and at CN3/CNAC (must be ≥198 V); check the F01 fuse on the control board
solutions.ur: TB1 aur CN3/CNAC par input voltage check karein (kam se kam 198 V hona chahiye); control board ka F01 fuse bhi check karein.

solutions.en: Check wiring between noise-filter board CN3/CN2 and control board CNAC, and the INV board SC-L1/L2/L3 wiring
solutions.ur: Noise-filter board CN3/CN2 aur control board CNAC ke darmiyan wiring check karein, aur INV board ki SC-L1/L2/L3 wiring bhi dekhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: New in V4 (20250819r1) — not present in V3. Very relevant to PK 3-phase supply quality.
notes.ur: Yeh V4 (20250819r1) mein naya hai — V3 mein nahi tha. PK ki 3-phase supply quality ke liye bohat ahem hai.

title.ur: Transmission power supply kharab

meaning.en: The transmission-line power supply circuit is faulty on one or more outdoor units.
meaning.ur: Transmission line power supply ka circuit ek ya zyada outdoor units par kharab hai.

causes.en: Fault in the transmission power supply circuit on an outdoor unit
causes.ur: Outdoor unit ke transmission power supply circuit mein kharabi ho.

causes.en: Wiring fault, high current or incorrect voltage on the transmission line / M-Net board
causes.ur: Transmission line / M-Net board par wiring kharab ho, current zyada ho ya voltage theek na ho.

solutions.en: Check the transmission power supply circuit on every outdoor unit in the refrigerant circuit
solutions.ur: Refrigerant circuit ke har outdoor unit par transmission power supply circuit check karein.

solutions.en: Check transmission line wiring and voltage, and the M-Net board
solutions.ur: Transmission line ki wiring aur voltage check karein, aur M-Net board ko bhi dekhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: New in V4. S8 documents 4106 as a City Multi transmission power supply fault (R410A column).
notes.ur: V4 mein naya hai. S8 ne 4106 ko City Multi ka transmission power supply fault bataya hai (R410A column).

title.ur: Fan ke chalne ki status pakadne mein ghalti

meaning.en: The unit cannot confirm that its fan is running as commanded.
meaning.ur: Unit yeh confirm nahi kar pa raha keh fan command ke mutabiq chal raha hai.

causes.en: Coil or wiring of the auxiliary relay on CN28 is faulty
causes.ur: CN28 par lage auxiliary relay ki coil ya wiring kharab ho.

causes.en: Connector not properly connected, or the control-board fuse is open
causes.ur: Connector theek se laga na ho, ya control-board ka fuse khula (blown) ho.

causes.en: Fan motor not operating in test-run mode
causes.ur: Fan motor test-run mode mein chal na raha ho.

solutions.en: Check the CN28 connector and the control-circuit fuse
solutions.ur: CN28 connector aur control-circuit fuse check karein.

solutions.en: Run the unit in test-run mode; if the fan still does not run, replace the fan motor
solutions.ur: Unit ko test-run mode mein chalayein; agar phir bhi fan chal na raha to fan motor badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: New in V4; applies to the indoor/damper side fan detection.
notes.ur: V4 mein naya hai; yeh indoor/damper side ki fan detection par lagu hota hai.

title.ur: RPM ki ghalti / motor ki ghalti

meaning.en: The motor's reported RPM does not match the command, or the motor has failed.
meaning.ur: Motor ka report kiya hua RPM command se match nahi karta, ya motor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Motor or solenoid switch fault
causes.ur: Motor ya solenoid switch mein kharabi ho.

causes.en: Board fault
causes.ur: Board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the motor and the solenoid switch
solutions.ur: Motor aur solenoid switch ko check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the board if the motor tests good
solutions.ur: Agar motor ki test theek aaye to board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: New in V4. S8 also has 4116 'Fan motor abnormal — relates to indoor unit or Lossnay'.
notes.ur: V4 mein naya hai. S8 mein bhi 4116 hai 'Fan motor abnormal — indoor unit ya Lossnay se related'.

title.ur: Function setting mein ghalti

meaning.en: A function-setting switch or connector on the control board is set incorrectly.
meaning.ur: Control board par function setting wala switch ya connector ghalat tarah se set kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: SW6-1 setting on the control board is wrong
causes.ur: Control board par SW6-1 ki setting galat hai.

causes.en: Something is connected to connector CNAF that should not be
causes.ur: CNAF connector par koi aisi cheez lagi hai jo nahi lagni chahiye.

solutions.en: Correct SW6-1 and confirm nothing is plugged into CNAF
solutions.ur: SW6-1 theek karein aur confirm karein ke CNAF par kuch laga na ho.

solutions.en: Replace the control board if both checks pass and the error remains
solutions.ur: Agar dono checks theek ho jayein aur error phir bhi rahe to control board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: New in V4.
notes.ur: Yeh code V4 mein naya shamil kiya gaya hai.

title.en: Electric system not operating due to damper abnormality
title.ur: Damper ki kharabi ki wajah se electric system nahi chal raha

meaning.en: A damper (lock motor ML1/ML2 or damper motor MV2) is obstructed or its limit switches are faulty.
meaning.ur: Damper (lock motor ML1/ML2 ya damper motor MV2) mein rokawat hai ya us ke limit switches kharab hain.

causes.en: Something physically obstructing the damper's opening/closing movement
causes.ur: Damper ke khulne aur band hone mein koi cheez atki ho.

causes.en: Damper lock motor or damper motor winding out of specification (ML1/ML2 235–255 Ω, MV2 282–306 Ω)
causes.ur: Damper lock motor ya damper motor ki winding specification se bahar ho (ML1/ML2 235–255 Ω, MV2 282–306 Ω).

causes.en: Damper limit switch or indoor electronic control P.C. board fault
causes.ur: Damper limit switch ya indoor electronic control P.C. board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Remove the obstruction, power off and measure ML1/ML2 and MV2 resistance against the specified ranges
solutions.ur: Pehle rukawat hata dein, power off karein aur ML1/ML2 aur MV2 ki resistance specified range se naapein.

solutions.en: Measure CN1X1/CN1Y1 voltages (0 V/5 V logic) during open and close to identify a bad limit switch versus a bad board
solutions.ur: Damper khulne aur band hone ke doran CN1X1/CN1Y1 voltages naapein (0 V/5 V logic) — is se pata chalega ke limit switch kharab hai ya board.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: New in V4 with full measurement procedure — ducted/cassette PK installs with motorised dampers.
notes.ur: V4 mein poore measurement procedure ke sath naya hai — PK ki ducted/cassette installs jin mein motorised dampers lage hain.

title.en: Bus voltage drop / rise / startup fault
title.ur: Bus voltage upar-neeche ya startup par kam hona

meaning.en: Inverter bus voltage has dropped or risen outside limits, the control power supply failed, or a logic error occurred.
meaning.ur: Inverter bus voltage limit se bahar gir gaya ya barh gaya, control power supply kharab ho gayi, ya logic error aa gaya.

causes.en: Mains supply out of range (V4 checks L1-L2, L2-L3, L1-L3 ≤342 V across all phases)
causes.ur: Mains supply range se bahar ho (V4 mein L1-L2, L2-L3, L1-L3 sabhi phases par ≤342 V check kiya jata hai).

causes.en: Faulty inverter board (4220), fan board (4225/4226), noise filter or control board
causes.ur: Inverter board (4220), fan board (4225/4226), noise filter ya control board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Measure the three-phase supply and correct it (fit/verify a stabiliser or transformer where the mains swings)
solutions.ur: Three-phase supply naapein aur theek karein (jahan mains upar-neeche ho, stabiliser ya transformer lagayein/verify karein).

solutions.en: Check inverter board, noise filter, fan board and control board; replace INV board for 4220 and fan board for 4225/4226 if the fault recurs
solutions.ur: Inverter board, noise filter, fan board aur control board check karein; agar fault wapas aaye to 4220 ke liye INV board aur 4225/4226 ke liye fan board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 gives thresholds: 'less than 289 Vdc detected — check mains supply' (4220) and 300 Vdc at CNVdc (4225).
notes.ur: S8 ke thresholds: '289 Vdc se kam mile — mains supply check karein' (4220) aur CNVdc par 300 Vdc (4225).

title.ur: Heatsink zyada garm hone ki protection

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature has exceeded the protection limit.
meaning.ur: Inverter heatsink ki temperature protection limit se zyada ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Blocked heat-sink cooling air passage
causes.ur: Heat sink ki cooling air passage band ho gayi ho, hawa na guzre.

causes.en: Fan inverter board or outdoor unit fan failure
causes.ur: Fan inverter board kharab ho ya outdoor unit fan band ho jaye.

causes.en: Improper installation of the INV board IGBT, or a failed thermistor
causes.ur: INV board IGBT theek se install na hua ho, ya thermistor fail ho jaye.

solutions.en: Clear the air passage around the heat sink and check the outdoor fan
solutions.ur: Heat sink ke ird-gird ki air passage saaf karein aur outdoor fan check karein.

solutions.en: Check the fan inverter board and the IGBT mounting; replace the thermistor/board if readings are wrong
solutions.ur: Fan inverter board aur IGBT ki fitting check karein; agar readings galat hon to thermistor/board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 threshold: 'High temperature (85°C) on heat sink on inverter'.
notes.ur: S8 ka threshold: 'Inverter ke heat sink par high temperature (85°C)'.

title.ur: Overload ki protection

meaning.en: High current has persisted beyond the allowed time, or a model-selection switch setting is wrong.
meaning.ur: High current ki condition ijazat time se zyada der rahi, ya model selection switch ki setting ghalat hai.

causes.en: Heat-sink cooling air passage blocked
causes.ur: Heat sink ki cooling air passage block ho gayi ho.

causes.en: Power supply voltage at or above 342 V
causes.ur: Power supply voltage 342 V ya us se zyada ho.

causes.en: Wrong model-selection dip switch setting (SW5-3…SW5-8) or inverter/compressor fault
causes.ur: Model-selection dip switch setting galat ho (SW5-3…SW5-8), ya inverter/compressor mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Clear the heat-sink airflow and verify the supply voltage
solutions.ur: Heat sink ki airflow saaf karein aur supply voltage verify karein.

solutions.en: Re-check SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection, then test the inverter and compressor
solutions.ur: SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection dobara check karein, phir inverter aur compressor test karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8: 'Over current protection. If high current is detected for more than 10 minutes'.
notes.ur: S8: 'Over current protection. Agar high current 10 minute se zyada detect ho.'

title.en: IPM error / short-circuit or instantaneous overcurrent
title.ur: IPM error / short circuit ya foran overcurrent

meaning.en: The inverter power module reports an IPM error, a ground fault, a shorted motor or an instantaneous overcurrent.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module IPM error, ground fault, motor ka short ya foran overcurrent ki khabar de raha hai.

causes.en: Compressor wiring loose, disconnected or shorted to earth
causes.ur: Compressor ki wiring dhili ho, khuli ho ya earth se short ho jaye.

causes.en: Defective compressor, defective outdoor power circuit board or fan inverter board
causes.ur: Compressor kharab ho, outdoor power circuit board kharab ho ya fan inverter board kharab ho.

causes.en: Wrong model-selection dip switch setting (SW5-3…SW5-8)
causes.ur: Model-selection dip switch setting galat ho (SW5-3…SW5-8).

solutions.en: Check inverter, compressor and IGBT; tighten and verify compressor wiring
solutions.ur: Inverter, compressor aur IGBT check karein; compressor ki wiring ko kassi karke theek se verify karein.

solutions.en: Verify the SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection and replace the failed board/compressor after isolation
solutions.ur: SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection verify karein aur power isolate karne ke baad kharab board/compressor badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: 4250/4255/4256 are grouped by V4 under 'Backup operation' with a shared check procedure. A PK technician video exists for City Multi 4350 (preliminary of 4250).
notes.ur: V4 mein 4250/4255/4256 ko 'Backup operation' ke tehat ek sath rakha gaya hai jis mein shared check procedure hai. City Multi 4350 (4250 ka preliminary) par PK technician ki video bhi maujood hai.

title.en: Temperature sensor fault — indoor unit thermistors
title.ur: Temperature sensor kharab — indoor unit ke thermistors

meaning.en: An indoor thermistor (TH21 return air, TH22 pipe, TH23 gas-side pipe, TH24 outside temperature) is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Indoor ka koi thermistor (TH21 return air, TH22 pipe, TH23 gas side pipe, TH24 outside temperature) open ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Thermistor disconnected from its holder or from the board
causes.ur: Thermistor apne holder se ya board se alag ho jaye.

causes.en: Thermistor characteristic defect or pinched/damaged lead wire
causes.ur: Thermistor ki characteristic kharab ho ya lead wire chubri/damaged ho.

solutions.en: Check the thermistor resistance: 0°C 15 kΩ, 10°C 9.7 kΩ, 20°C 6.4 kΩ, 30°C 4.3 kΩ, 40°C 3.1 kΩ
solutions.ur: Thermistor ki resistance check karein: 0°C par 15 kΩ, 10°C par 9.7 kΩ, 20°C par 6.4 kΩ, 30°C par 4.3 kΩ, 40°C par 3.1 kΩ.

solutions.en: Check connector contact and the lead wire; if no fault is found, the indoor board has failed
solutions.ur: Connector ka contact aur lead wire check karein; agar koi kharabi na mile to indoor board fail ho chuka hai.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: 5101–5104 are indoor-side; 5102/5103/5106/5107/5115 also cover outdoor thermistors (TH2/TH3/TH4/TH6/TH7/TH15). Always read the fault-code address to know which unit.
notes.ur: 5101–5104 indoor side ke hain; 5102/5103/5106/5107/5115 outdoor thermistors (TH2/TH3/TH4/TH6/TH7/TH15) par bhi aate hain. Kis unit ka masla hai yeh janne ke liye hamesha fault-code address parhein.

title.ur: Heatsink temperature sensor kharab (THHS)

meaning.en: The inverter heatsink temperature thermistor THHS is open or shorted.
meaning.ur: Heatsink temperature thermistor THHS open ya short ho gaya hai.

causes.en: THHS thermistor disconnected or failed
causes.ur: THHS thermistor khud juda ho gaya ho ya fail ho jaye.

causes.en: Inverter board fault
causes.ur: Inverter board kharab ho.

solutions.en: Check the THHS thermistor resistance and its connector
solutions.ur: THHS thermistor ki resistance aur us ka connector check karein.

solutions.en: If the fault recurs when the unit is put back into operation, replace the INV board
solutions.ur: Agar unit ko dobara chalane par fault wapas aaye to INV board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 lists 5110 as 'TH10 open/short circuit' in the R22/R407c columns and 'THHS' in the PWFY table — read the unit context.
notes.ur: S8 mein 5110 ko R22/R407c columns mein 'TH10 open/short circuit' aur PWFY table mein 'THHS' likha hai — unit ka context parhein.

title.ur: High pressure sensor kharab (63HS1)

meaning.en: The high-pressure sensor reading disagrees with gauge pressure or the sensor/circuit has failed.
meaning.ur: High pressure sensor ki parya gauge pressure se match nahi karti, ya sensor/circuit kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Defective high-pressure sensor (63HS1)
causes.ur: High-pressure sensor (63HS1) kharab ho.

causes.en: Pressure drop from gas leak, or connector/input-circuit fault
causes.ur: Gas leak ki wajah se pressure girta ho, ya connector/input circuit mein kharabi ho.

solutions.en: Compare the sensor reading with gauge pressure and check the connector
solutions.ur: Sensor ki reading gauge pressure se compare karein aur connector check karein.

solutions.en: Repair any leak and verify the input circuit on the outdoor controller board
solutions.ur: Jo bhi leak ho use theek karein aur outdoor controller board par input circuit verify karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: Also documented by S8 (5201 pressure sensor fault at outdoor unit / BC box).
notes.ur: S8 ne bhi isay document kiya hai (5201 — outdoor unit / BC box par pressure sensor fault).

title.en: ACCT sensor / current sensor circuit fault
title.ur: ACCT sensor / current sensor ka circuit kharab

meaning.en: The ACCT current sensor or its circuit is faulty, or its connector is open/loose.
meaning.ur: ACCT current sensor ya us ka circuit kharab hai, ya us ka connector open/loose hai.

causes.en: Open-circuited IPM / loose ACCT connector (CNCT2 on the INV board)
causes.ur: IPM open circuit ho, ya ACCT connector dhila ho (INV board par CNCT2).

causes.en: Faulty ACCT wiring or sensor
causes.ur: ACCT ki wiring ya sensor kharab ho.

causes.en: Inverter/compressor fault
causes.ur: Inverter/compressor mein masla ho.

solutions.en: Check connector CNCT2 and the output wire for proper connection
solutions.ur: CNCT2 connector aur output wire ko theek se juda hona check karein.

solutions.en: Check inverter and compressor; replace the INV board if the problem persists after resuming operation
solutions.ur: Inverter aur compressor check karein; operation dobara shuru karne ke baad bhi masla rahe to INV board badlein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 adds the bench value: 'should read 280 ohms between pins 1 & 2 and across pins 3 & 4' for 4245.
notes.ur: S8 mein 4245 ke liye bench value bhi di gayi hai: 'pins 1 & 2 ke darmiyan aur pins 3 & 4 par 280 ohms aana chahiye'.

title.ur: Address ki dohar (duplicate address)

meaning.en: Two or more units on the system carry the same address.
meaning.ur: System par do ya zyada units ka address aik hi hai.

causes.en: Duplicated addressing after commissioning or a board swap
causes.ur: Commissioning ya board change ke baad address duplicate ho jaye.

causes.en: Noise interference on indoor/outdoor connectors
causes.ur: Indoor/outdoor connectors par noise interference ho.

solutions.en: Re-assign unique addresses to the conflicting units and power-cycle
solutions.ur: Conflict wali units ko unique addresses dein aur unit ka power cycle karein.

solutions.en: If the units run normally the error may be accidental — clear it and re-read
solutions.ur: Agar units theek se chal rahe hon to yeh error galti ka ho sakta hai — isay clear karke dobara parhein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: Same condition as Mr. Slim A-control A0.
notes.ur: Yeh condition Mr. Slim A-control A0 jaisi hi hai.

title.ur: Line par koi jawab nahi mila

meaning.en: A unit on the transmission line did not acknowledge — the addressed controller did not respond.
meaning.ur: Transmission line par kisi unit ne jawab nahi diya — jise address diya gaya tha us controller ne jawab nahi diya.

causes.en: Address switch changed while powered, or the addressed unit does not exist
causes.ur: Power on rehte hue address switch badal gaya ho, ya diya gaya address kisi unit par mojood hi na ho.

causes.en: Transmission voltage/signal drop: farthest unit >200 m, remote-controller line >12 m, wrong wire type/diameter (<1.25 mm²), too many units
causes.ur: Transmission voltage/signal girna: sab se door wali unit >200 m, remote-controller line >12 m, wire ka type/diameter galat (<1.25 mm²), units bohat zyada.

causes.en: Noise or lightning surge, or a defective controller
causes.ur: Noise ya lightning surge ho, ya controller kharab ho.

solutions.en: Turn the units off for 5 or more minutes, then on again and re-read the code
solutions.ur: Units ko 5 ya zyada minute band rakhein, phir on karein aur code dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Check transmission line voltage (~25 V), wire type (CVVS/CPEVS/MVVS) and diameter ≥1.25 mm², and confirm addresses/connectors (CN2M) are correct
solutions.ur: Transmission line voltage (~25 V), wire type (CVVS/CPEVS/MVVS) aur diameter ≥1.25 mm² check karein, aur addresses/connectors (CN2M) sahi hain yeh confirm karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: V4 splits 6607 by cause: outdoor side, indoor side, remote-controller side, Fresh Master side, Lossnay side and 'controller not recognised'.
notes.ur: V4 mein 6607 ko wajah ke hisab se toda gaya hai: outdoor side, indoor side, remote-controller side, Fresh Master side, Lossnay side aur 'controller not recognised'.

title.ur: Line se koi jawab nahi aaya

meaning.en: Continuous failure to receive a response frame — typically noise or an out-of-spec transmission line.
meaning.ur: Jawab frame milna barqarar nahi raha — aam tor par noayz ya transmission line ki specification se bahar hone ki wajah se.

causes.en: Continuous transmission failure caused by noise
causes.ur: Noise ki wajah se transmission lagatar fail hota hai.

causes.en: Line length/diameter/type out of specification
causes.ur: Line ki length/diameter/type specification se bahar ho.

causes.en: Accidental malfunction of the error-source controller
causes.ur: Galti se error-source controller ne theek se kaam karna band kar diya ho.

solutions.en: Power off for 5 minutes and re-read the code
solutions.ur: 5 minute ke liye power off rakhein aur code dobara parhein.

solutions.en: Verify farthest end <200 m, remote line <12 m, wire ≥1.25 mm², shielded type; remove noise sources
solutions.ur: Sab se door wala end <200 m, remote line <12 m, wire ≥1.25 mm², shielded type ho yeh verify karein; noise ke sources hata dein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: V4 states plainly: 'Noise is the most possible cause of the error 6608'.
notes.ur: V4 saaf kehta hai: 'Error 6608 ki sab se mumkin wajah noise hai'.

title.ur: Total capacity mein ghalti (capacity zyada)

meaning.en: The sum of the connected indoor units' capacity codes exceeds the outdoor unit's allowed total.
meaning.ur: Lage hue indoor units ki capacity codes ka jama outdoor unit ki ijazat se zyada ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Qj total (capacity code total) of connected indoor units exceeds the limit
causes.ur: Jude hue indoor units ka Qj total (capacity code total) limit se zyada ho jaye.

causes.en: Wrong capacity code (SW2) on an indoor board
causes.ur: Indoor board par capacity code (SW2) galat ho.

causes.en: Wrong outdoor model-selection dip switch setting
causes.ur: Outdoor ka model-selection dip switch setting galat ho.

solutions.en: Check the Qj total and correct SW2 capacity codes on the indoor boards
solutions.ur: Qj total check karein aur indoor boards par SW2 ke capacity codes theek karein.

solutions.en: Re-check the outdoor SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection and confirm TB3 connections between OC and OS
solutions.ur: Outdoor SW5-3…SW5-8 model selection dobara check karein aur OC aur OS ke darmiyan TB3 connections confirm karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 threshold wording: 'R2 150% index exceeded / Y 130% index exceeded'.
notes.ur: S8 ka threshold: 'R2 150% index exceed / Y 130% index exceed kar gaya'.

title.ur: Lage hue units ki tadaad ghalat hai

meaning.en: More indoor units and branch boxes are connected than the outdoor unit allows.
meaning.ur: Outdoor unit ki ijazat se zyada indoor units aur branch boxes lage hue hain.

causes.en: More than the limit connected (V4/PUMY: up to 12 indoor units and 2 branch boxes, at least 1 indoor unit)
causes.ur: Limit se zyada units jude hue hain (V4/PUMY: 12 indoor units aur 2 branch boxes tak, kam se kam 1 indoor unit).

causes.en: Transmission line for TB7 accidentally wired to TB3, or M-Net voltage lost (short/break)
causes.ur: TB7 ki transmission line galti se TB3 par lagi ho, ya M-Net voltage gayab ho (short/break).

solutions.en: Reduce the connection count within the limits and verify TB3/TB7 wiring on the outdoor unit
solutions.ur: Connection ki tadaad limit ke andar kar dein aur outdoor unit par TB3/TB7 wiring verify karein.

solutions.en: Check the outdoor model-selection switch (SW5-7) and the transmission line for shorts or breaks
solutions.ur: Outdoor model-selection switch (SW5-7) aur transmission line ko short/break ke liye check karein.

source.title: City Multi VRF outdoor PUCY-YKA/YKD/YKE 4-digit codes [S4]

notes.en: S8 wording: 'Error in number of connected units — loss of M-Net voltage, no power to BC, wrong SW5 setting'.
notes.ur: S8 ka alfaz: 'Connected units ki tadaad mein error — M-Net voltage gayab, BC ko power na, SW5 setting galat'.
